name: 190 East Coast Blocc Crips
description: The 190 East Coast Blocc Crips are a subset of the East Coast Crips based in the Del Amo area of Carson, California. In 2016, the final defendant in a RICO indictment targeting the East Coast Crips pleaded guilty to federal racketeering involving violent crimes, home invasion robberies, and crack cocaine distribution.
